stock.description: Anhui Jinyan Kaolin New Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the mining, research and development, processing, production, and sales of calcined kaolin products in China. The company's products include kaolin starch and ore, all-natural calcined mullite, refractory materials, precision casting mullite sand, and precision casting mullite powder. It also sells raw coke and raw powder. It serves the automotive, aviation, healthcare, and general equipment industries. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Huaibei, China.
